sources.title: DeepSeek R1 Distill Qwen 7B - Zentree-Qualcomm Pre-compiled Model ...
sources.snippet: The DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B is a distilled version of the Qwen2.5-Math-7B large language model (LLM), optimized for efficient performance while retaining high-quality generative capabilities and is particularly suited for scenarios where computational efficiency is critical.

sources.title: DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B · Models
sources.snippet: DeepSeek-R1 achieves performance comparable to OpenAI-o1 across math, code, and reasoning tasks. To support the research community, we have open-sourced DeepSeek-R1-Zero, DeepSeek-R1, and six dense models distilled from DeepSeek-R1 based on Llama and Qwen.
